title: Read booking mails automatically
intro: Booking confirmations arrive in the inbox as proposals by themselves – either from a mail folder TravStats reads, or through a forwarding address. An entry exists only once you confirm it. Off until you switch it on.
loadError: The settings could not be loaded.

off.admin: The administrator has switched booking-mail intake off.
off.account: Booking-mail intake is switched off for your account.
off.forbidden: The administrator does not allow booking-mail intake for this account.

folder.title: Your own mail folder (IMAP)
folder.help: TravStats reads only this one folder, for example "TravStats". A filter, or you, put bookings there. Read mails are flagged as read and get the keyword $TravStats; nothing is deleted or moved. Use an app password (Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, GMX).
folder.passwordSaved: Saved – leave empty to keep it
folder.name: Folder
folder.privateNote: Only public servers are allowed; a server on your own network cannot be entered here.

errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
errors.tls_error: The secure connection failed (certificate or encryption).
errors.auth_failed: Login refused – user name or (app) password is wrong.
errors.folder_missing: The folder does not exist on the server.
errors.credentials_missing: No password is stored. Enter it again, for example after a restore.
errors.plain_not_allowed: Unencrypted IMAP is not allowed for a personal folder.
errors.blocked_host: This server is not on the public internet and cannot be used.
errors.protocol_error: The server answered unexpectedly. The cause is in the server log.
errors.MAIL_HOST_BLOCKED: This server is not on the public internet and cannot be used.

forwarding.title: Forwarding address
forwarding.help: Forward booking mails to this address, or set up an automatic forwarding rule in your mail program. Only mail from the senders you allow below is accepted, and your mail provider must confirm it is genuine (DMARC).
forwarding.unavailable: The administrator has not set up a forwarding address yet.
forwarding.sendersHelp: The address you forward from – not the airline's.
forwarding.noSenders: No sender allowed yet – mail to your address is rejected.

inbox.title: From your mail
inbox.description: Booking mails TravStats read by itself. Accept opens the mail in the import; an entry is created only there.
inbox.allowed: Sender allowed. Forward the mail once more.
inbox.deletesOn: The mail is deleted on {{date}} unless it is filed with an entry by then.
inbox.openError: The mail could not be opened.
inbox.sourceProblem: Your mail folder could not be read:

reasons.mail_too_large: The mail is too large (over 2 MB).
reasons.unknown_token: The address is unknown or revoked.
reasons.dmarc_failed: The mail provider rejected the sender's authenticity (DMARC).
reasons.dmarc_unverified: The mail provider did not confirm the sender's authenticity (DMARC).
reasons.unreadable_mail: The mail could not be read.
reasons.nothing_found: No booking was recognised in the mail.
reasons.llm_not_allowed: No booking recognised – AI reading is switched off or not permitted.
reasons.document_not_kept: The mail could not be stored.
reasons.service_off: Mail intake is switched off for this account.
reasons.from_invalid: The mail has no single, clear sender.

admin.title: Forwarding mailbox (booking mails)
admin.help: One mailbox for the whole instance. Each account gets its own plus address from it (for example trips+k7m2q9xwab@example.org). The provider must support plus addresses. TravStats only reads the mailbox over IMAP.
admin.authservHelp: When set, only the Authentication-Results header carrying this id is believed.
admin.plainNote: Unencrypted IMAP is allowed here for a mailbox on your own network.
